annotations.title: Get the CV of a referral request

description: Requires techjobs.vn sign-in, and a verified referrer account. Returns a short-lived download link to the CV the candidate sent with a referral request, as it was when they sent it. Only for a request this user claimed (claim_referral_request first). The first time it is opened, techjobs.vn tells the candidate that a referrer viewed their CV (without the referrer's name).
name: get_referrer_request_cv

cv_url.description: Download link for the candidate's CV (PDF or Word). Do not store or share it.

expires_in_seconds.description: The link stops working after this many seconds; call again for a new one.

title: Get the CV of a referral request
